Statement

if Statement

In the .sjs file, you can use the if statement in the following format:

  • if (expression) statement: If expression is truthy, execute statement.
  • if (expression) statement1 else statement2: If expression is truthy, execute statement1. Otherwise, execute statement2.
  • if ... else if ... else statementN: Select a statement from statement1 to statementN for execution.

Example:

// if ...
if (expression) statement;
if (expression) statement;
if (expression) {
    code block;
}
// if ... else
if (expression) statement;
else statement;
if (expression) statement;
else statement;
if (expression) {
    code_block;
} else {
    code_block;
}
// if ... else if ... else ...
if (expression) {
    code_block;
} else if (expression) {
    code_block;
} else if (expression) {
    code_block;
} else {
    code_block;
}

switch Statement

Example:

switch (expression) {
    case variable:
        statement;
    case number:
        statement;
        break;
    case string:
        statement;
    default:
        statement;
}
  • The default branch is optional.
  • The case keyword can be followed only by variables, digits, and character strings.

for Statement

Example:

for (statement; statement; statement) statement;
for (statement; statement; statement) {
    code_block;}
  • Keywords break and continue are supported.

while Statement

Example:

while (expression) statement;

while (expression) {
    code_block;
}

do {
    code_block;} while (expression);
  • When expression is true, the statement or code block is executed cyclically.
  • Keywords break and continue are supported.
